_how: Wednesday Psalm Reels rotate through every psalm in assets/psalms.json, in 'order', one per week starting on 'start'. Long psalms are split into parts of about 'max_chars_per_reel' characters (roughly a one-minute Reel), so nothing repeats until the whole set has been read. See the rotation with: python3 -m social.psalm_plan --list. To pick a psalm for one particular Wednesday, add it under 'dates', e.g. "2026-12-23": {"name": "Psalm 50", "from": 1, "to": 6}.
